data.summary: The contractor presents perfect ratings but with no review content to verify authenticity. The Google Maps listing shows 13 reviews, yet the strategic sample contains zero reviews, which is highly suspicious. The BBB A+ rating and Angi 5-star rating lack the detailed customer narratives needed to assess genuine quality. The absence of any review text makes it impossible to evaluate authenticity, customer experiences, or warranty follow-through.

data.discrepancy_explanation: The company has a perfect 5-star rating on Google and Angi, but there are zero actual review texts provided for analysis. The BBB shows an A+ rating with no complaint data, but this reflects accreditation and complaint handling, not service quality. The lack of any review content across all platforms is a major red flag.
